root: ^I continued my research per your suggestion. But something happened and I need your help.

^I'm detained by the police or military or something and my daughter is all alone close to the village of Dreslawa. All of my research is there as well. I need you to get my files and Orianna and take her to safety right now, maybe to your house until the situation cools off? She always loved your dogs...

^She is still asleep, in a cellar of a bombed house about a mile outside the village. The house is close to the edge of the forest. You can find a key to the hatch door under the garden gnome next to the small garden patch.
^They can't know what's inside this letter or what I was doing, they're blaming me for unimaginable things. Don't believe anything they say, Klaus, they are lying to you.
